description_en: Updates the title or pinned status of a session
description_zh: 更新会话标题或置顶状态
name: UpdateSession

parameters.help_en: The ID of the session to update
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to pin the session. If you do not specify this parameter, the pinned status remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 是否置顶；不传则保持不变
parameters.name: pinned

parameters.help_en: The new title of the session. If you do not need to update the title, do not specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的会话标题；无需更新可不传
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The idempotency key for the request. Use the same value when you retry the same update request
parameters.help_zh: 请求幂等键。同一更新请求重试时使用相同值
parameters.name: x_open_agent_idempotency_key

createdAt.description_en: The time when the session was created, in RFC 3339 format
createdAt.description_zh: 会话创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式

lastRunId.description_en: The ID of the last run

lastRunStatus.description_en:
The status of the last run. Valid values:
`PENDING`: Pending.
`RUNNING`: Running.
`WAITING_USER`: Waiting for interrupt handling.
`COMPLETED`: Completed.
`FAILED`: Failed.
`CANCELLED`: Cancelled.
`REJECTED`: Rejected
lastRunStatus.description_zh: 最近一次运行状态：`PENDING`（待执行）、`RUNNING`（运行中）、`WAITING_USER`（等待中断处理）、`COMPLETED`（已完成）、`FAILED`（失败）、`CANCELLED`（已取消）、`REJECTED`（已拒绝）

pinned.description_en: Indicates whether the session is pinned

status.description_en:
The session status. Valid values:
`IDLE`: Idle.
`ACTIVE`: Active.
`WAITING_USER_INPUT`: Waiting for user input.
`WAITING_APPROVAL`: Waiting for user confirmation.
`WAITING_OUT_OF_BAND_APPROVAL`: Waiting for out-of-band approval.
`CLOSED`: Closed
status.description_zh: 会话状态：`IDLE`（空闲）、`ACTIVE`（运行中）、`WAITING_USER_INPUT`（等待用户输入）、`WAITING_APPROVAL`（等待用户确认）、`WAITING_OUT_OF_BAND_APPROVAL`（等待带外审批）、`CLOSED`（已关闭）

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the session was last updated, in RFC 3339 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 会话最近更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The session information to update. Specify at least one of the title and pinned fields
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 要更新的会话信息，title 和 pinned 至少填写一项
v1_body_parameters.name: body
